task.instruction: Find a popular JavaScript repository created in the last 30 days on GitHub with a Readme file.

final_answer:
I found **heydamir/unslop** — https://github.com/heydamir/unslop

It's a JavaScript repository created on **October 29, 2026** (well within the last 30 days), and it's currently the most-starred JavaScript repo in that window with roughly **11,100 stars** and 607 forks. It has an active README.md (about 3.5 KB) at https://github.com/heydamir/unslop/blob/main/README.md.

Per its README, unslop is a skill for Claude Code and Codex that turns "vibecoded," AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character — it hunts down the purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing, then fixes the screen pass by pass like a designer doing a redline review. It works with Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML/CSS, on dashboards, apps and landing pages, and even on a live site when all you have is a link. It's licensed CC-BY-4.0 and authored by Damir Sokolevsky (@heydamir).

judge.rationale: API evidence shows heydamir/unslop is JavaScript, created 2026-10-29, has 11,100 stars, and README.md exists; search sorted by stars showed it top.
